sources.resists: every creature weenie (weenie.type 10, WeenieType.Creature) of the world database (ace_world, ACE's open world database, the server's own copy: the same rows the ground profiles' facts come from) that records any of its seven damage resistances, read with one read-only SELECT through server/runtime/mariadb-ace.cnf on 2026-11-16 (6,451 rows): SELECT w.class_Id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 64 THEN f.value END), 1), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 65 THEN f.value END), 1), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 66 THEN f.value END), 1), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 67 THEN f.value END), 1), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 68 THEN f.value END), 1), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 69 THEN f.value END), 1), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN f.type = 70 THEN f.value END), 1) FROM ace_world.weenie w JOIN ace_world.weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = w.class_Id AND f.type BETWEEN 64 AND 70 WHERE w.type = 10 GROUP BY w.class_Id ORDER BY w.class_Id
sources.columns: wcid; then weenie_properties_float 64 ResistSlash, 65 ResistPierce, 66 ResistBludgeon, 67 ResistFire, 68 ResistCold, 69 ResistAcid, 70 ResistElectric, each 1 when the weenie records none (ACE's default: Creature.GetResistanceMod reads ResistX ?? 1.0, Creature_Properties.cs:185-205 @95ef426d); a creature weenie absent from the table records none, so all seven are 1
sources.use: M6 14 the element line (TODO(m6-fight-element-line) closed): the fight casts, at each target, the bolt line of her book that hits it hardest: ACE's war projectile damage (SpellProjectile.CalculateDamage, SpellProjectile.cs:490-560 @95ef426d) is the same for every element's line level by level and is multiplied by the target's resistance to the element (BoltElement.Best, CreatureResists.Of)
sources.scope: M6 item 16 E1e (2026-11-17): the table is written by the generator now (pwsh -File tools/fight-sim.ps1 bestiary; the columns are listed in tools/fight-sim/BestiaryTables.cs), which reads the same rows through ACE's own models, queries only. The SELECT quoted above is the first extraction's and takes weenie.type 10 only; the generator also takes weenie.type 15 (WeenieType.Cow), which ACE builds as a Creature subclass (Source/ACE.Server/WorldObjects/Cow.cs:7, Source/ACE.Server/Factories/WorldObjectFactory.cs:49-50 @95ef426d) that a generator places and a player can fight: the world database holds 17 such weenies (the Low B belt's cattle among them, weenie classes 20, 181 and 182). Added: their 17 rows (each states a resistance); the table now holds 6,468 rows. No other row changed (bestiary --check before the refresh: 0 with a different row). The other weenie types ACE builds as a Creature subclass are left out, each with why in tools/fight-sim/BestiaryRows.cs (AceIds.LeftOut): Vendor (1,179 weenies), CombatPet (259), Pet (29) and GamePiece (12).
